body:
Source: docs/specs/decision-layer-shadow.md (P1: three interrogation rounds, premortem and spec-lint recorded against this ticket; supersedes the shadow-mode portion of docs/specs/jev-opt-in-decision-layer.md for v1). Replaces the unmerged feat/jev-opt-in-decision-layer branch, which grew enforce mode and trust-root changes the spec never asked for.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR. As specified in docs/specs/decision-layer-shadow.md, which this ticket freezes as its rail. A new package @adlc/decision-layer and one CLI verb `adlc decision evaluate`, mode `off` (default, no-op) or `shadow` only. Shadow runs sanitize declared metadata, ask a provider a versioned question pack (packs ship inside the package), reduce the answers deterministically, and append one record with ticket/PR join keys to .adlc/decisions/runs.jsonl in the main checkout. No answer can change any exit code, ticket, rail, routing, review requirement or verdict. Only the offline mock provider ships until one live Jev response is captured as the adapter's contract fixture. No change outside the package except the CLI registration and the docs/registry entries a new package needs; no .gitignore change.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (AC1-AC3 and AC5-AC12 of the spec, each with its verify command; AC4, the Jev adapter, is the follow-up ticket).
- AC1 another verb never resolves the package. verify: `node --test packages/decision-layer/test/isolation.test.mjs`
- AC2 bad mode, provider without mode, jev without key or fixture, and a pack shadowing a shipped ID exit 1 with nothing sent and no record. verify: `node --test packages/decision-layer/test/cli.test.mjs`
- AC3 offline mock; the default suite fails if fetch is reached. verify: `node --test packages/decision-layer/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC5 sanitizer rules. verify: `node --test packages/decision-layer/test/sanitizer.test.mjs`
- AC6 pack validation rules. verify: `node --test packages/decision-layer/test/pack-validator.test.mjs`
- AC7 reducer total, never allow for unknown/error. verify: `node --test packages/decision-layer/test/reducer.test.mjs`
- AC8 exit code independent of answers. verify: `node --test packages/decision-layer/test/evaluate.test.mjs`
- AC9 record fields, no sanitized input. verify: `node --test packages/decision-layer/test/evaluate.test.mjs`
- AC10 records from a linked worktree land in the main checkout with join keys, path ignored. verify: `node --test packages/decision-layer/test/evaluate.test.mjs`
- AC11 every repository guard for packages/* passes. verify: `npm run preflight`
- AC12 no enforce-mode code in lib. verify: `node --test packages/decision-layer/test/isolation.test.mjs`

OUT OF SCOPE: the Jev adapter (follow-up ticket, after a live fixture is captured); enforce mode; caching; diagnostics retention; signing records into the C11 manifest; calling the layer from P0/D1/P5/C8; deciding who runs shadow evaluations and when; calibration scoring; any change to core, prosecute, model-router, gate-manifest or other trust-root paths.
title: decision-layer: opt-in shadow mode (Jev and mock providers, run log only)
